title: Stakeholder Pressure Dampening & Rolling-Commit Roadmap for High-Touch Accounts
creator: Avery Chen
description: Background: As Redwood scales adoption with strategic customers, PM & Sales are increasingly fielding time-sensitive escalation asks that threaten roadmap focus and engineering capacity. These requests often originate from high-touch accounts with contractual expectations, and friction arises when ad-hoc commitments are made without a structured accept/deflect mechanism. Objective: Design and pilot a lightweight framework that (1) reduces ad-hoc concessioning to high-touch accounts by smoothing stakeholder pressure, (2) enables predictable rolling commits (timeboxed, measurable scope), and (3) integrates with existing intake and release tooling so commitments are visible to Eng, Sales, and Customer Success. Scope: Define decision thresholds, acceptance criteria, a 'pressure score' signal, rollout workflow for pilot cohort (5 strategic accounts), and dashboarding for commitment SLAs and slippage. Out of scope: major contractual renegotiation and full legal SLA changes (handled by Sales/Legal).
acceptance_criteria: Framework doc published in Confluence with decision thresholds, escalation flow, and 2 example runbooks
Pilot cohort (5 accounts) onboarded and trained on expectations and the rolling-commit model
Console indicators added: commitment-owned flag + slippage metric per request
No more than 2 unauthorized roadmap concessions during pilot period (8 weeks)
Eng retrospective with measured lead-time to delivery and % of commitments met (goal >= 80%)
tasks: Draft pressure-scoring rubric (signals: MRR, contract terms, exec escalation, incident impact, product dependency)
Define rolling-commit contract template (timebox window, scope cap, rollback/fallback triggers)
Integrate commit flag and slippage fields into intake form and Console (product-management + eng tickets)
Create pilot communications kit for Sales and CSMs (FAQ, email templates, in-meeting script)
Instrument dashboard in Looker for live tracking (commit count, slippage %, lead time, unauthorized concessions)
Run pilot with 5 accounts for 8-week window and collect feedback
